queries.sql: select catalog_name, schema_name from `region-us`.information_schema.schemata order by schema_name

select t.table_name as table_name, t.table_type as table_type, t.creation_time as creation_time, d.option_value as description, s.total_rows as total_rows, s.total_logical_bytes as total_logical_bytes, s.storage_last_modified_time as last_modified from `demo-project`.`ops`.information_schema.tables t left join `demo-project`.`ops`.information_schema.table_options d on d.table_name = t.table_name and d.option_name = ? left join `demo-project`.`region-us`.information_schema.table_storage s on s.table_schema = t.table_schema and s.table_name = t.table_name and s.project_id = t.table_catalog and not s.deleted order by t.table_name limit ?

select t.table_name as table_name, t.table_type as table_type, t.creation_time as creation_time, d.option_value as description, s.total_rows as total_rows, s.total_logical_bytes as total_logical_bytes, s.storage_last_modified_time as last_modified from `demo-project`.`shop`.information_schema.tables t left join `demo-project`.`shop`.information_schema.table_options d on d.table_name = t.table_name and d.option_name = ? left join `demo-project`.`region-us`.information_schema.table_storage s on s.table_schema = t.table_schema and s.table_name = t.table_name and s.project_id = t.table_catalog and not s.deleted order by t.table_name limit ?

select c.table_name as table_name, c.column_name as column_name, c.ordinal_position as ordinal_position, c.data_type as data_type, c.is_nullable as is_nullable, c.column_default as column_default, f.description as description from `demo-project`.`ops`.information_schema.columns c left join `demo-project`.`ops`.information_schema.column_field_paths f on f.table_name = c.table_name and f.column_name = c.column_name and f.field_path = c.column_name where c.table_name in (?, ?) order by c.table_name, c.ordinal_position

select c.table_name as table_name, c.column_name as column_name, c.ordinal_position as ordinal_position, c.data_type as data_type, c.is_nullable as is_nullable, c.column_default as column_default, f.description as description from `demo-project`.`shop`.information_schema.columns c left join `demo-project`.`shop`.information_schema.column_field_paths f on f.table_name = c.table_name and f.column_name = c.column_name and f.field_path = c.column_name where c.table_name in (?, ?, ?, ?) order by c.table_name, c.ordinal_position

select k.table_name as table_name, k.constraint_name as constraint_name, tc.constraint_type as constraint_type, tc.enforced as enforced, k.column_name as column_name, k.ordinal_position as ordinal_position, k.position_in_unique_constraint as unique_position, u.table_catalog as ref_catalog, u.table_schema as ref_schema, u.table_name as ref_table, u.column_name as ref_column, pk.ordinal_position as ref_position from `demo-project`.`ops`.information_schema.key_column_usage k join `demo-project`.`ops`.information_schema.table_constraints tc on tc.constraint_catalog = k.constraint_catalog and tc.constraint_schema = k.constraint_schema and tc.constraint_name = k.constraint_name and tc.table_name = k.table_name left join `demo-project`.`ops`.information_schema.constraint_column_usage u on u.constraint_catalog = k.constraint_catalog and u.constraint_schema = k.constraint_schema and u.constraint_name = k.constraint_name and tc.constraint_type = ? left join (select pkk.table_catalog as table_catalog, pkk.table_schema as table_schema, pkk.table_name as table_name, pkk.column_name as column_name, pkk.ordinal_position as ordinal_position from `demo-project`.`ops`.information_schema.key_column_usage pkk join `demo-project`.`ops`.information_schema.table_constraints pkc on pkc.constraint_catalog = pkk.constraint_catalog and pkc.constraint_schema = pkk.constraint_schema and pkc.constraint_name = pkk.constraint_name and pkc.table_name = pkk.table_name where pkc.constraint_type = ?) pk on pk.table_catalog = u.table_catalog and pk.table_schema = u.table_schema and pk.table_name = u.table_name and pk.column_name = u.column_name where k.table_name in (?, ?) order by k.table_name, k.constraint_name, k.ordinal_position
